## Branch roles

| Role | Branch | Protected |
| ---- | ------ | --------- |
| `mainline` | | yes |
| `integration` | branch PRs land in first, or `none` for a single-branch project | yes |
| `base` | what new work branches from | |
| `work` | naming pattern for short-lived branches | no |

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Repository default branch | what `EnterWorktree` and fresh clones pick |
| PRs required into protected branches | yes / no |

## Verification gates

Run in this order. **Status** is one of `wired` (a hook or CI job also runs it),
`not wired` (nobody runs it but you), or `broken` (records what it fails to cover).

| Command | Covers | Status |
| ------- | ------ | ------ |
| | | |

| Field | Value |
| ----- | ----- |
| Filtered invocation | single-package form used while iterating, or `none` |
| Full local CI command | one command running every gate, or `none` |
